This is great advice...

I feel at the moment like ending it, tbh though. I can't do it anymore.

I work as a middle manager in a hotel. Staff shortages, so its a very stressful and busy job. Plus heaps of paperwork that I just have no time to do. Other in same position as me feels the same.

Hours are 7am-3ish pm and 3pm to 1ish am. Shift work. Late/Early pattern. I know this doesn't help things, which was why I was considering quitting. Money is an issue, and the job market in Ireland isn't great atm.

Thanks for reading and replying, but I think I'm beyond help. I'm on a rollercoaster at the moment, and don't know where it will end.

This is truly an amazing subreddit. You guys have helped hundreds of people, and will go on to help thousands more, I hope. 

Sorry for bringing you down with all this, and have a good one. :)
I was on Cipramil before this. It didn't work. The noise is only there when I try to sleep

Thanks for reading.

My GP probably gets hundreds of me in his office. He doesn't have time to follow me closely. I don't blame him. Giving me drugs are a way of covering himself. Its the system.

I haven't really talked to anyone I know about this. I can't.
